sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach have been in strong form with seven wins from their last ten matches. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five outings.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive with second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) hosting Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from consecutive losses. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in another closely-matched fixture between mid-table challengers. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, host Wednesfield Community on Saturday before the midweek clash with Brereton Social on Wednesday 7 October. In-form Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) are at home to Foley Meir, while Barnton welcome New Mills in a mid-table encounter. Elsewhere, Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday in a clash involving a struggling bottom side; Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town in a battle between two of the division's poorest performers; Crewe host Allscott Heath; and Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills on Saturday.
